name: implement
title_zh: 测试先行、审过才合入的活儿，它替你盯着落地
tagline_zh: 从 ticket 到 PR 全流程照看：先写红测试、再改代码、审完才合入。子代理或主循环里派活都认它。
tagline_en: Turns tickets into landed PRs: red test, code, review, merge. Works from subagents or Loops, so you don't babysit.
desc_en: Implement a piece of work from a spec, ticket or brief - test-first, reviewed, landed as a pull request. Use whenever the work is to build, change or fix something in a Project or the Kit, including from a subagent or a Loop.
why_zh: 把「完成」定义成「测试绿 + 评审过 + 已合入」三段闸门，任何一段没走完它都算没干完。
why_en: Defines 'done' as three gates—tests green, review passed, PR merged. Skips none, so you never get half-finished work dressed as.
limit_zh: 只认仓库里有测试框架和 CI 的项目；若目标仓库没配好测试运行器，它会卡在第一步反复问你要命令。产物止于 PR 创建。
limit_en: Needs a test runner and CI in the target repo; otherwise it stalls asking for commands. Stops at PR creation—won't iterate on review feedback.
